items.headline: EPFO wage ceiling badhakar ₹25,000 hua
items.what: Cabinet ne EPFO ki mandatory coverage ki wage ceiling ₹15,000 se badhakar ₹25,000 kar di hai.
items.who: Woh employers jinke employees ki monthly basic wage ab ₹25,000 tak hai, EPFO me cover honge.
items.action: Aapko apne kaamgaaron ki naukri details ko EPFO requirement ke hisaab se update karna hoga.

items.headline: EPFO wage ceiling Gazette notification jaari
items.what: Labour Ministry ne EPFO ki wage ceiling 25,000 par Gazette notification jaari kiya hai.
items.who: Sab employers aur unke eligible employees par lagu hai.
items.action: Nayi wage limit ke mutabik details, compliance check karein.

items.headline: Rajasthan to add 1,150 e-buses under PM e-Bus Scheme
items.what: Rajasthan sarkar PM e-Bus Scheme ke tahat 1,150 naye electric buses la rahi hai.
items.who: Urban transport operators aur bus manufacturers par asar padega.
items.action: Scheme ke guidelines aur procurement update follow karein.

items.headline: Karnataka sarkar movie ticket par 2% cess lane ki planning mein
items.what: Karnataka sarkar movie ticket par 2% additional cess lagane ki yojana bana rahi hai.
items.who: Cinema hall owners, viewers aur ticketing portals par asar padega.
items.action: Nayi tax rate lagu hone par ticket pricing update karein.

items.headline: Gujarat MSMEs ki GIS mapping shuru
items.what: Gujarat Government ne MSMEs ki GIS mapping shuru kari hai, taki industrial data ko PM Gati Shakti se joda ja sake.
items.who: State ki MSMEs aur industrial planners.
items.action: Jo MSMEs shamil hona chahen, process ya portal par registration karen.

items.headline: CBDT ne IIT Roorkee ko research tax benefits diye
items.what: CBDT ne IIT Roorkee ko scientific research par tax benefit approve kiya hai for 5 years under Income Tax Act.
items.who: IIT Roorkee aur iske research project sponsors.
items.action: Jo bhi research donors hain, eligible donation par tax benefit claim kar sakte hain.

items.headline: Tax valuer, practitioner registration deadline March 2027 tak badhi
items.what: CBDT ne tax valuers aur practitioners ki registration ki deadline March 2027 tak extend ki hai.
items.who: Sab tax valuers, practitioners aur naye applicants.
items.action: Aap March 2027 tak registration submit kar sakte hain.
